title: Notification Settings
description: Configure notification and voice features for Dish.

textToSpeech.title: Text-to-Speech
textToSpeech.description: When enabled, Dish will read its responses aloud using text-to-speech.
textToSpeech.enableDescription: Automatically read content aloud using voice when the AI generates a response.

soundNotifications.title: Sound Notifications
soundNotifications.description: When enabled, Dish will play sound effects for notifications and events.
soundNotifications.enableDescription: Play a sound when a notification is received or an action is completed.

systemNotifications.title: System Pop-up Notifications
systemNotifications.description: When enabled, Dish will display system-level pop-up notifications.
systemNotifications.enableDescription: Display pop-up notifications in the system notification center (e.g., when a commit or weekly report is generated).
systemNotifications.macOsAlertDescription: Please ensure VS Code has permission to send notifications in 'System Settings > Notifications'. This feature relies on 'terminal-notifier', which can be installed via Homebrew: brew install terminal-notifier.
systemNotifications.linuxAlertDescription: This feature relies on 'node-notifier'. If notifications do not appear, try installing libnotify-bin (e.g., sudo apt-get install libnotify-bin on Debian/Ubuntu).
systemNotifications.windowsAlertDescription: This feature works best on Windows 8/10 and above. It relies on 'SnoreToast' for notifications.
